page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, centred. Page number at the top right. Heading "14. De Foedere." above the text. No marginal notes. Signature at the bottom left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.head: 14. De Fœdere.
main_text.p: SCoti isti Presbyterales haud vulgari Auxi-liorum stipendio invitandi, nullo alio pre-tio in partes trahuntur quam animarum pignore posito, Ipsis scilicet qui illos evocabant, Solenni Pacto & Fædere constri-ctis.

Multæ hîc piæ Machinæ, & Religiosi prætextus afferuntur ad oppugnandum Episcopatum vel prorsus demoliendum. Hunc nempe Grandem Illum Cacodæmona, quem (terriculamentis nonnullis adjectis) odio vulgi, & pavoribus objiciunt, Solenni Carmine & Exorcismo ex Ecclesia omni modo abigendum; postquam eam mille annos obsederit, ex quo primo Christianismus in hac Insula plantatus, quique præscripto Universa-si temporis simul & præxeos [?]in cæteris omnibus Ecclesiis, usque ab Apostolorum sæculo, ad hanc proximam Centuriam, innititur.
Sed frustra caufam hic agit Antiquitas: Presbyterismus velut adolescens hæres, nimis diu Patrem vixisse ratus, & Episcopalis Cathe-

page.notes: Running head is Greek; the printed form reads ΒΑΣΙΑΙΚΗ (with Α where Λ is expected), kept as printed. "Universa-si" at the line end: the second part is unclear, read as "si" with [?]. "præxeos sin" in the line: "sin" is doubtful, read as printed with [?]; likely "in". Long s is set as plain s throughout. The heading's "Fœdere" is read from the scan as "Foedere" in the top line; body uses "Fædere". Paragraph 3 ends mid-word at "Cathe-" and the catchword "drae," belongs to the next page.
